facts.en: Completed a farm-business basics course at Fictional Hedgerow Adult School in 2023; it issued a completion record rather than an occupational licence.
facts.zh: 2023 年在虚构篱行成人学校完成农场业务基础课程；颁发结课记录，而非职业执照。

facts.en: Paid part-time packing assistant at Fictional Wrenbasket Egg Farm from 2024-06 to 2026-08, contracted for 24 hours per week.
facts.zh: 2024-06 至 2026-08 在虚构鹪篮蛋场任有薪兼职包装助理，合同为每周 24 小时。

facts.en: Placed already graded eggs into cartons specified by the packing lead.
facts.zh: 将已分级鸡蛋放入包装负责人指定的纸盒。

facts.en: Matched supplied grade, batch and date labels with the order sheet before sealing cartons.
facts.zh: 封盒前将提供的等级、批次及日期标签与订单表匹配。

facts.en: Set aside visibly damaged cartons or unclear labels and recorded the affected order references.
facts.zh: 将可见损坏纸盒或标签不清的包装留置，并记录受影响订单编号。

facts.en: The grading team determined grades and product-release status; the candidate packed from the released stock.
facts.zh: 分级团队确定等级及产品放行状态；候选人使用已放行库存包装。

facts.en: Counted filled cartons by customer order and kept unused cartons in the packaging-stock count.
facts.zh: 按客户订单清点装满纸盒，并将未使用纸盒计入包装材料库存。

facts.en: Helped check the packaging-stock register in 2025-08.
facts.zh: 2025-08 协助检查包装材料库存登记表。

facts.en: That check found 240 empty cartons with 12 egg spaces each, representing capacity for 2880 eggs rather than an actual egg count.
facts.zh: 该检查发现 240 个空纸盒，每盒有 12 个蛋位，代表可容纳 2880 个鸡蛋，而非实际鸡蛋数量。

facts.en: No eggs were counted in that packaging-stock check.
facts.zh: 该次包装材料库存检查未清点鸡蛋。

facts.en: Recorded dispatch-box references and handed order sheets to the delivery coordinator.
facts.zh: 记录发货箱编号，并将订单表交给配送协调员。

facts.en: Uses batch-label templates, manual count sheets and spreadsheet packaging totals.
facts.zh: 使用批次标签模板、人工计数表及电子表格包装材料汇总。

facts.en: Completed the farm’s internal packing-room induction in 2024-06.
facts.zh: 2024-06 完成农场内部包装室入职培训。

facts.en: Co-created a carton-size reminder card with a packing colleague in 2026-02; personally drew the size icons from approved examples.
facts.zh: 2026-02 与一名包装同事共同制作纸盒尺寸提醒卡；个人依据获批示例绘制尺寸图标。

facts.en: Volunteered with Fictional Meadowspoon Community Breakfasts from 2022-01 to 2023-09.
facts.zh: 2022-01 至 2023-09 在虚构草匙社区早餐团体做志愿者。

facts.en: At those breakfasts, arranged reusable place settings and tracked borrowed tableware returns; meal preparation was handled by the kitchen team.
facts.zh: 在这些早餐活动中摆放可重复使用餐具，并跟踪借用餐具归还；备餐由厨房团队负责。

facts.en: Keeps a personal sketch diary of backyard birds observed during leisure walks, with no veterinary or commercial husbandry work.
facts.zh: 保留个人素描日记，记录休闲步行时观察的后院鸟类，不涉及兽医或商业饲养工作。

facts.en: Made a personal set of paper bird mobiles in 2025 for a community craft display.
facts.zh: 2025 年为社区手工展示制作个人纸鸟悬挂装饰组。

facts.en: Enjoys building miniature woven-paper nests.
facts.zh: 爱好制作微型编纸鸟巢。

facts.en: Left end-of-shift notes distinguishing unfilled orders from packaging materials awaiting replenishment.
facts.zh: 留下班末备注，区分未完成订单与等待补充的包装材料。
